pin_diff.note: Feedback network difference: one device has fixed internal divider while the other requires external R1/R2 feedback resistors.

parameter_matrix.note: Synchronous rectification eliminates external Schottky diode loss and PCB area.
Compact WSON/VSON/SOT-563 packages demand tight hot-loop layout and thermal vias.
Verify cold-start minimum startup voltage and bus surge ceiling.
Provides transient overshoot margin above nominal DC supply bus.
Fixed-output variants save divider BOM; adjustable parts allow arbitrary rail tuning.
For boost converters, usable Iout ≈ Isw × (Vin / Vout) × η minus half ripple ΔIL/2.
Dominates light-load efficiency and standby battery runtime.
Higher fsw shrinks inductor footprint; lower fsw reduces switching losses & high-band EMI.
Check datasheet efficiency curve at your exact Vin/Vout/Iout operating point.
Ensure inductor Isat exceeds worst-case peak switch current by >= 20–30%.
Any Vref discrepancy requires recalculating feedback divider R1/R2.
Lower θJA improves continuous load thermal headroom on compact 2-layer PCBs.

swap_risks: HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 55% (AP63203WU-7: 1100 kHz p.5 vs AP63300WU-7: 500 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (AP63203WU-7: 3.9 µH p.13 vs AP63300WU-7: 6.8 µH p.2); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: AP63203WU-7 specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs AP63300WU-7 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
engineering_verdict: AP63203WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and AP63300WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to switching frequency differs >30%; recommended inductor value differs >20%; fixed vs adjustable output configuration differs. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency is 1100 kHz (p.5) vs 500 kHz (p.6), rated current is 2000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 3.9 µH (p.13) vs 6.8 µH (p.2), and Iq is 22 µA (p.5) vs 22 µA (p.6). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.1), thermal margin (θJA 89 vs 89 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
